name: Qwen Image 2.1
author: michaeldune
description: Qwen-Image 2.1, the 7B model that writes lettering correctly and edits from plain words. Text to image at 1 MP and at the model's full ~4 MP, in three speeds: the main card (about 35 s a picture on a 12 GB card), Turbo (Qwen's official 8-step LoRA, about 15 s, still good at small lettering), and Fast Drafts (Viggle's 5-step LoRA, about 11 s, for trying ideas), plus Fast (HDR), Fast Drafts through Felldude's HDR VAE for punchier colour. Turbo 4MP makes a 4 MP picture in about 40 s instead of about 1.5 minutes. Two plain edit cards: Edit (one to four reference pictures) and Fast Edit (PrunaAI's 8-step LoRA, about 20 s for a one-picture edit instead of about 80). One 17 GB download covers the main, 4MP and Edit cards; each faster card adds its LoRA. Since 2.0.0 the eight edit cards that do one job (Steady Frame, Edit 4MP, Enhance to 4MP, Cutout, Character Sheet, Head Swap, Outfit Swap, Pose Studio) are in the Qwen Image 2.1 Edit Tools pack, which shares this pack's model, encoder and VAE. LICENCE: the weights are under the Qwen Research License, which allows NON-COMMERCIAL use only; do not use these cards for paid or commercial work.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1
presets.tagline: Fast text-to-image with lettering that spells
presets.description:
Text to image that follows long prompts and spells lettering correctly. Put the words you want on signs, labels and posters in quotes. About 35 seconds per picture on a 12 GB card.

For a transparent background, start the prompt with: This is an RGBA image with transparency.

Then end it with: The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.

Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE). All three cards share one set of weights from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1: the int8 ConvRot model (7.3 GB), the int8 ConvRot Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (9.4 GB) and the 2.1 VAE (0.7 GB). Official template settings: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple. Needs ComfyUI v0.37.0 or newer (the first release with Qwen-Image 2.1 support, core commit 6bfaacc67). Tested 2026-09-20 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (stock ComfyUI master): 16 s per 1024x1024 or 1344x768 picture at 25 steps, about 9.4 GB VRAM in use; a five-word shop sign came out letter-perfect; the RGBA prompt produced real alpha. SINCE 1.4.0 (2026-09-22): guided sampling - CFG 3, 20 steps, seeds_2/sgm_uniform, Adaptive Projected Guidance (1/10/0.3) and FreSca (1/2/8), with a negative prompt - replacing the Comfy template's CFG 1. Tested on 2 prompts x 3 seeds (text to image) and 2 seeds (edit, 1 and 4 references): lettering on signs and menus went from mostly garbled to readable, colour stayed natural, identities held; about 2.4x the time (1 MP text to image ~34 s, one-reference edit ~88 s, four references ~6 min on a 4070 Ti). IN THE APP (2026-09-22): text to image 44 s with a letter-perfect sign and menu; one-reference edit 95 s, identity and clothes kept. The negative prompt is built into the workflow (StringConcatenate) because the app sends an empty negative_prompt; anything the user types is appended.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Fast Drafts
presets.tagline: Five-step drafts in a few seconds
presets.description:
Text to image in 5 steps, for trying ideas and seeds quickly: about 11 seconds per picture on a 12 GB card, against about 40 for the main card. Move a keeper to the main Qwen Image 2.1 card for the final picture.

Photos, portraits and poster headlines hold up well. Small or long lettering garbles more often than on the main card, and now and then an object comes out doubled, so re-roll the seed.

Steps and CFG are fixed by Viggle's built-in turbo LoRA (a v0.2 preview), so there are no sliders.

Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE); the Viggle LoRA is a derivative under the same licence. Shares the pack's Qwen-Image 2.1 weights (int8 ConvRot model 7.3 GB, int8 Qwen3-VL 8B encoder 9.4 GB, VAE 0.7 GB) and adds Viggle/Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo v0.2 (Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo-v0.2-5step-lora-r256.safetensors, rank 256, 1.36 GB, DMD-distilled; repo commit e57a0bb, sha256 pinned in the pack checksums) through LoraLoaderModelOnly at strength 1 after SimpliGen's LoRA slot. Sampling per the model card: 5 steps, euler, CFG 1, no negative, on the nodes [1, 0.875, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25]; those are RAW nodes that diffusers time-shifts, and ManualSigmas skips the model shift, so the workflow carries them pre-shifted for ~1 MP (mu 0.6935: 1, 0.93446, 0.85833, 0.66667, 0.4, 0); every aspect ratio in the table is within 0.4% of that mu. Tested 2026-09-23 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine, int8 base), 5 prompts x 3 seeds against the 25-step base: portrait, poster and a one-reference edit on par; a small shop sign garbled more (1 of 3 misspelled, 1 of 3 with a doubled accordion) and a product edit merged the shoe on 1 of 3 - this card is text-to-image only. Steady state ~3 s per new seed vs ~12 s for the old 25-step base (text encode ~4 s more on a new prompt, same for both); the first run after another Qwen card spends ~5 s patching the LoRA in. Peak VRAM ~11.5 GB. IN THE APP (2026-09-23): 4 pictures (3:4 poster, two 16:9 photo seeds, 9:16 interior) at 11.1 s each; the app re-encodes the prompt and re-applies the LoRA on every job, so the 3 s reseed seen on the bare engine does not happen in the app. Poster headline and tagline letter-perfect, a small chalkboard sign readable, nothing doubled.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Fast (HDR)
presets.tagline: Fast drafts with punchier colour and crisper detail
presets.description:
The Fast Drafts card with a different finish. It makes the same 5-step picture but decodes it through Felldude's HDR VAE, which pushes colour, contrast and fine detail harder: richer skin and sky tones, crisper pores, fabric and lettering.

It is a look, not a quality upgrade, and it has a cost. Bright areas clip sooner, so white clothing, snow and flat anime shading can blow out and lose their detail, and dark areas go blacker. It is also a few seconds slower per picture.

Use it for photo-style prompts. Use Fast Drafts for anime, line art and anything with large white areas.

Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

The encoder half of this VAE was also checked on the Fast Edit graph and changes nothing visible; the look comes from the decoder.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo
presets.tagline: Qwen's own 8-step Turbo, small text included
presets.description:
Text to image in 8 steps, using Qwen's official Turbo as a LoRA. About 15 seconds per picture on a 12 GB card, the same as Fast Drafts, and it keeps what Fast Drafts loses: in our side-by-side a small hand-painted sign inside a street scene came out correct on 3 of 3 seeds here and on none with Fast Drafts, and the scene followed the prompt more closely.

Use this card for pictures with lettering in them. Fast Drafts stays for the very quickest tries.

Steps and CFG are fixed by the LoRA, so there are no sliders.

Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 4MP
presets.tagline: Text to image at the model's full 4-megapixel size
presets.description:
Text to image at the size Qwen publishes for the model: about 4 megapixels (2048 x 2048 square, 2752 x 1536 wide). Much finer skin, hair and fabric than the 1 MP card, and small lettering comes out cleaner.

About 1.5 minutes per picture on a 12 GB card at 25 steps. For signs and small lettering, raise the steps to 40 (about 2.5 minutes).

Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo 4MP
presets.description:
The Turbo card at Qwen's full size: about 4 megapixels (2048 x 2048 square, 2752 x 1536 wide) in 8 steps. About 40 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card, against about 1.5 minutes for the 4MP card, with skin, hair and small faces on a par with it in our side-by-side.

This is where Turbo looks best. At 1 MP it smooths skin and softens faces that are small in the frame; at 4 MP that detail is back.

It tends to give the same centred framing from seed to seed, so change the prompt, not the seed, for a different shot. Count people and read every word before you use a picture.

Steps and CFG are fixed by the LoRA.

Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Edit
presets.tagline: Edit or combine up to four pictures by describing the change
presets.description:
Describe the edit in plain words and refer to the pictures by position: Keep the woman in <image1> unchanged, put the jacket from <image2> on her.

Use one to four reference pictures. Each extra one adds time: about 1 1/2 minutes for one and 6 minutes for four on a 12 GB card.

The result uses the aspect ratio you pick, so choose the one that matches your first picture when the framing should stay the same.

Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Fast Edit
presets.description:
Describe the edit and refer to the pictures by position, as on the main Edit card: Change the thread in <image1> to green. A one-picture edit takes about 20 seconds on a 12 GB card instead of about 80, thanks to PrunaAI's built-in few-step LoRA (v0.1).

It works best with one picture: colour and clothing changes, weather and time of day, and swapping a word on a sign all held up in testing.

It takes up to three pictures. With two or three it is still much faster than the main Edit card but less reliable: small objects can deform and a picture can end up partly hidden. Re-roll the seed, or use the main Edit card for a final multi-picture composite.

If an edit comes back harsh and grainy with the change only half made, change the seed. This happens when the edit uses the same seed that generated the picture you are editing.

Steps and CFG are fixed by the LoRA, so there are no sliders.

Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE); the Pruna LoRA is a derivative under the same licence. Same int8 base, encoder and VAE as the other cards plus PrunaAI/Pruna-Qwen-Image-2.1 p_qwen_image_2.1_8step_v0.1 (336 MB, rank-64 DMD distillation, trained at 1K with up to 3 references; pinned to revision 113e63b, sha256 f0865d68...bb15). Recipe per the model card: LoRA strength 1.0, euler, CFG 1, empty negative, sigmas 1, 14/15, 6/7, 10/13, 2/3, 6/11, 0.4, 2/9, 0 used UNSHIFTED (ManualSigmas). Graph = the Edit card minus APG/FreSca/negative prompt, LoRA before the reference prefix cache; the fourth reference slot is removed because the distillation covers three. Tested 2026-09-25 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine), same seeds against the main Edit card. One reference, 3 sources: 3/3 correct (dress colour + lanterns with the face kept, snow + a changed chalkboard word with the shop sign intact, thread colour + an added magnifier), sampler 5 s vs 54 s. Two or three references, 3 cases: 2/3 usable (a woman placed at a shop door; woman + shop + cat on her lap) and 1/3 failed (tweezers stretched into a blade, part of a menu hidden), sampler 11-19 s vs 138-216 s. PrunaAI call v0.1 work in progress; re-pin when they publish a new version. IN THE APP (2026-09-25, test pack): one-reference menu edit (a price changed from 5 to 7, a coffee cup drawn in) 20.7 s including the cold model load, every other menu line untouched; two-reference edit (woman from one picture at the door of the bakery in the other, holding a bread bag) 28.4 s, shop sign and chalkboard unchanged. SAME-SEED NOTE (1.9.1): when the edit seed equals the seed that generated the source picture at the same size, the edit starts from the source's own noise and comes out over-sharpened and stippled with the edit half applied. Tested 2026-10-04: 7 of 7 such collisions broke (engine and app), 18 of 18 other seed/source pairs were clean; turning the reference cache off made no difference; the 20-step Edit card was clean in the same collision (1 case). Workflow unchanged.
